changes: Replaced the upstream TIndexBounds import with its local structural type; no upstream dependency graph was imported.
Constructed DataView with the source view byteOffset and byteLength.
Bounded each growth-neighbor lookup by x and y so image edges cannot wrap into adjacent rows.
Added non-null assertions for source reads bounded by validated dimensions, for noUncheckedIndexedAccess.
Added this attribution comment; normalized formatting with the repository formatter.
Extracted BezierLine and PointLine with only their required Vec2 and scalar helpers into bezier-line.ts.
Replaced the upstream vector type with SourcePoint and copyObj with a point copy.
Initialized direction explicitly and added bounded-read assertions for strict TypeScript.
Adapted eraser stamp spacing and synchronous finalization into brush.ts. Added local independent hardness, selection, crop, periodic clipping, Restore, and cumulative coverage.
Kept draft planes separate from immutable accepted input planes. Removed upstream Canvas, history, pressure, and UI dependencies.
Clipped brush samples to the native render rectangle in continuous source coordinates before periodic wrapping.
Added source-over paint with an explicit color and opacity, while retaining erase and Restore modes.
Reused one preview bitmap and emitted dirty rectangle updates; retained cumulative stroke bounds for final publication.
wrapperPolicy: Validate source dimensions, RGBA data, binary selection, integer seed, tolerance, grow and contiguous before computation.
Copy source RGBA and canonicalize RGB to zero when alpha is zero.
Reject seeds outside explicit selections and reclip grown output to the selection.
Clamp growth to the maximum image dimension, which already reaches every image pixel.
